vars.objective: Find a way east across the Shattered Sea toward Aurenne. Warden Hale runs Keelhaven (the big hull, north side).
journal: The day before the Kindling. The Hierophant himself is coming to Lanternfall. Mom read my letters.
I woke up. Fennick says it's been a year. He says there are no days anymore. He made me eat soup.
Fennick built cairns for Mom and Dad. He was Dad's friend — "Fen." He's the one who left books on my step, every month, for eleven years. He gave me a sword.
A kite-courier named Linnet says there's a Mender girl running a hospital in the ruins of Aurenne. Ilse. She's alive. Folk blame "the Keeper's daughter." Fennick told Linnet my name is Lark.
The Ashmaw — Fennick's chicken-thief — attacked on the bridge. I fought it alone. I won. Fennick said, "There she is."
Keelhaven: a town made of upturned boats. There's a notice on the gate about "the Keeper's daughter," with a noose drawn under it. I told them my name is Lark.
